# ClearWorld

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Blitz3D](Blitz3D) · [World](Blitz3D-World)

</div>


```blitzbasic
ClearWorld:Void entities:Int32=1, brushes:Int32=1, textures:Int32=1
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `entities` | In | Int32 | `1` | True to free every entity. Defaults to True. |
| `brushes` | In | Int32 | `1` | True to free every brush. Defaults to True. |
| `textures` | In | Int32 | `1` | True to free every texture. Defaults to True. |

## Description

Frees entities, brushes and textures in one call, which suits changing from one level to the next. After it, handles of the cleared kind are no longer valid, so do not use them again. Cameras and lights are entities too, so create them again afterwards.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Graphics3D 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()

; Level one.
camera = CreateCamera()
cube = CreateCube()
tex = CreateTexture(64, 64)
EntityTexture cube, tex

; Level two begins with an empty world.
ClearWorld
camera = CreateCamera()
Text 8, 8, "Textures left: " + ActiveTextures()
Flip
WaitKey
```
